composite.title: Supplementary composite ranking (Chapter 3)
composite.formula: CS = 0.25*SU~ + 0.25*CSR~ + 0.25*(1-CC~) + 0.25*(1-Rob~); ~ = min-max across the four configurations within an instance; CC = (z_ET + z_PM)/2; Rob = sd of SU across runs within the instance
composite.recommendation_note: no configuration distinguished: the Friedman test on the composite score is not significant
